tools.name: get_lifecycle
tools.description: Where the game is: main_menu, loading or in_game, and which save is loaded. Works without a loaded colony.

tools.name: load_save
tools.description: Load a test clone from the main menu. Only saves whose file and folder both start with oni- are accepted.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: The colony at a glance: time and speed, worlds and their coordinate bounds, every duplicant (id, position, current chore, stress and what causes it, health, breath, calories, air, status), food, breathable gas, power, the game's own alerts, current research, and pending blueprints and dig marks. Names can repeat; the id is the save's own and every tool that takes a duplicant accepts it. colony.food_report_kcal is the game's daily food report in the form of oxygen_report_kg: today_made, today_used (negative) and yesterday_net, in kcal. Made counts harvests and butchering but not dishes a cooking station makes; used counts meals and the edible ingredients cooked. today_cooked is the kcal of dishes cooking stations made this cycle; yesterday_cooked is the same for the previous cycle, or null when counting began after it started; cooked_counted_since_cycle is when counting began (the save's load).

world.description: World id from worlds[]. Default: the active world.

tools.name: get_map
tools.description: An area of the map as text, one character per cell and one grid per layer, each with its legend. The top row is the highest y; x and y are game cell coordinates and rulers are included. Unrevealed cells are '?'. Areas above 64x48 are downsampled, and cells_per_char says by how much, so omit x, y, w and h for a thumbnail of the whole world.

x.description: Left edge. Default: the world's left edge.

y.description: Bottom edge. Default: the world's bottom edge.

w.description: Width in cells. Default: to the world's right edge.

h.description: Height in cells. Default: to the world's top edge.

world.description: World id. Default: the active world.

tools.name: inspect
tools.description: One cell in detail: element, mass, temperature, germs, every building there (id, operational state, the game's status lines such as missing power, stored contents) and loose items.

tools.name: get_buildable
tools.description: Buildings by build category. Unlocked ones list size, placement rule, materials with what the colony has, power use or output, and pipe and power ports (x, y offsets from the building's origin). Locked ones list the tech that unlocks them.

category.description: One build category, such as base, oxygen, power, food, plumbing, hvac. Default: all.

world.description: World whose stock is counted. Default: the active world.

tools.name: get_research
tools.description: Research: the current tech and queue, a missing research building if any, finished techs, and details (cost, progress, prerequisites, unlocks) of the techs that can be researched now.

scope.description: open: techs available now (default). all: the whole tree.

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: What changed since the last look: cycles, alerts raised and cleared, buildings completed and removed, duplicants lost, arrived or short of breath (with id and name), research completed. Pass the next_since from the previous call; missed says how many events aged out.

since.description: Return events after this sequence number. Default: 0.

tools.name: build
tools.description: Place a blueprint of any unlocked building; duplicants then construct it. (x, y) is the building's origin: its bottom row, centre column, rounded left for even widths, and get_buildable's port offsets are relative to it. A refusal returns the game's reason; a place inside solid rock is allowed and is dug out first. The id returned is the blueprint's: the finished building gets a new one, reported by get_events. For wires, pipes and rails use build_path.

rotation.description: Default: Neutral. get_buildable's rotations field says what a building allows.

materials.description: One element per ingredient, in the order get_buildable lists them. Default: whichever valid element the colony has most of.

tools.name: build_path
tools.description: Lay a wire, pipe or rail along a path of neighbouring cells, or a run of ladders or tiles. To branch from an existing line, make an existing cell of that line part of the path: only a shared cell connects, so being adjacent is not enough. All or nothing: on a refusal nothing is placed.

def_id.description: A building id whose get_buildable entry has utility: true.

cells.description: [x, y] pairs, each one step up, down, left or right of the one before.

materials.description: One element per ingredient, in the order get_buildable lists them. Default: whichever valid element the colony has most of.

tools.name: dig
tools.description: Mark a rectangle for digging. Reports how many cells were marked and why others were skipped.

tools.name: deconstruct
tools.description: Mark buildings for deconstruction, by building id or by rectangle. The printing pod is protected.

id.description: Building id from inspect. Use this or x and y.

tools.name: cancel
tools.description: Remove dig marks, blueprints and deconstruction marks in a rectangle.

tools.name: set_priority
tools.description: Set the priority (1-9) of a building or errand, by id or by rectangle.

id.description: Building id from inspect. Use this or x and y.

tools.name: set_research
tools.description: Research a tech, replacing the current queue. Unfinished prerequisites are queued first, and the response shows the resulting queue.

require_ready.description: Refuse instead of queueing prerequisites. Default: false.

tools.name: set_speed
tools.description: 0 pauses; 1, 2 and 3 run the game at the three speeds. Pause before planning a complicated layout. 4 is ten times normal speed, for long unattended stretches; time_scale sets another multiple for it. Above 10 the game runs as fast as the CPU allows, which can be well under the multiple asked for, and duplicants may decide more slowly; go back to 4 or lower for careful play.

tools.name: save_checkpoint
tools.description: Save to a new checkpoint file next to the loaded save. Existing saves are never overwritten.

note.description: Why this point is worth keeping.

tools.name: list_buildings
tools.description: Finished buildings with id, position, whether they run, and the game's status lines. Wires, pipes, tiles and ladders are left out unless def or include_structural asks for them. problems_only shows what is not running, and why.

world.description: World id. Default: the active world.

tools.name: get_resources
tools.description: What the colony can reach right now: elements, food and items in kg, largest first.

world.description: World id. Default: the active world.

tools.name: find
tools.description: The nearest things of a kind, among revealed cells: an element such as Algae, a loose or stored item, a building, a harvestable plant, or a revealed geyser. Answers with up to five, and the total.

query.description: Element, item or building id; part of a plant id. Empty lists every plant.

limit.description: How many to list, up to 100. Default: 5.

x.description: Measure from here. Default: the first duplicant.

world.description: World id. Default: the active world.

tools.name: get_progress
tools.description: The stage goal's numbers now and one row per cycle finished this session: duplicants, food, breathable gas, oxygen and power, and open alerts. Use it to judge trends.

tools.name: harvest
tools.description: Have duplicants harvest the plants in a rectangle when ready, wild ones included. enable false stops that. find with kind plant locates them.

tools.name: sweep
tools.description: Mark loose items in a rectangle to be carried to storage. Needs a storage building.

tools.name: mop
tools.description: Mark shallow liquid on a floor to be mopped up. Deep liquid is reported and needs pumping.

tools.name: configure
tools.description: Set up a finished building. recipe with count queues a recipe on a fabricator such as a MicrobeMusher; count -1 repeats forever and 0 clears it. seed plants in a planter or farm tile. storage_filter sets what a storage building accepts, replacing the old list. assigned_duplicant assigns individual furniture through the game's normal assignment rules. MassageTable stress thresholds control when massage starts and stops. inspect lists recipes, seeds, filters, assignment (kind, id, name) and massage thresholds.

id.description: Finished building id from list_buildings or inspect.

element_filter.description: Element a GasFilter or LiquidFilter picks out. The picked element leaves by the middle cell, everything else by the far end.

assigned_duplicant.description: Duplicant id from get_status as a string, or a unique living duplicant name. Shared names are refused as ambiguous_duplicant with candidate_ids. Empty string releases the assignment: public use when allowed, otherwise unassigned. Null is not accepted. Room-managed furniture cannot be individually reassigned.

massage_start_stress.description: MassageTable only: start massage at this stress percentage. Omitted retains its current value. Must be at least massage_stop_stress.

massage_stop_stress.description: MassageTable only: stop massage at this stress percentage. Omitted retains its current value. Must not exceed massage_start_stress; give both to change the range together.

crew.description: Duplicants assigned to board a rocket habitat module, each an id from get_status such as "101" or a name only one living duplicant has; a shared name is refused as ambiguous_duplicant, listing candidate_ids. An empty list releases crew.

rocket_restriction.description: Restrict grounded rocket interior access on a RocketControlStation to assigned crew only or unrestricted.

rocket_action.description: Rocket starmap command on a LaunchPad, rocket module, or RocketControlStation: select adjacent space orbit hex, trigger/cancel launch, or return to land on a LaunchPad.

tools.name: set_chore_priority
tools.description: How much one duplicant likes a kind of work: 0 never, 5 most. A refusal lists the chore groups.

duplicant.description: Id from get_status, such as "101", or a name only one living duplicant has; a shared name is refused as ambiguous_duplicant, listing candidate_ids.

chore_group.description: Such as Dig, Build, Cook, Research, Farming, Hauling.

tools.name: set_schedule
tools.description: Replace a schedule's day. get_status shows schedules in the same form.

blocks.description: One character per block of the day: H hygiene, W work, R recreation, S sleep.

tools.name: get_skills
tools.description: Each duplicant's id, unspent skill points, what they have mastered, and what they could learn now (with whether they are interested, which affects morale).

tools.name: learn_skill
tools.description: Spend a skill point. Some work needs a skill, such as the advanced research station or digging the hardest rock.

duplicant.description: Id from get_status, such as "101", or a name only one living duplicant has; a shared name is refused as ambiguous_duplicant, listing candidate_ids.

tools.name: get_printables
tools.description: The printing pod's current offer: duplicants with traits, interests and attributes, and care packages. Each has an index for choose_printable. With nothing on offer, says how long until the next one. get_status shows printables_waiting.

tools.name: choose_printable
tools.description: Print one option from get_printables. Each new duplicant eats and breathes, so check food and oxygen first.

tools.name: reject_printables
tools.description: Turn down the whole offer. The pod starts counting towards the next one.

tools.name: wait
tools.description: Let the game run for up to 60 real seconds, then return what happened. Returns early when a serious alert appears or a duplicant is lost. Pass the next_since from the last get_events or wait. Time passes only if the game is not paused.

since.description: Return events after this sequence number.
